summary: iOS keyboard · compact header, circular Chrome and private link cleaning

changes.title: Circular Chrome shortcut
changes.detail: Transparent inline Chrome glyph replaces the white adaptive launcher plate; keeps real Chrome availability and secure explicit navigation.

changes.title: Compact keyboard
changes.detail: When word suggestions are disabled or not required and no contextual action is active, the suggestion header shrinks to rounded-corner clearance without changing key height. Header measurement handles alternate panel/view hierarchies safely.

changes.title: Native password managers
changes.detail: Allow genuine Android inline autofill in toolbar-only mode and center provider content; explicit hidden mode, private vault and locked-device exclusions remain. Provider supplies its own labels and actions. Centering uses the Android Gravity API with its explicit import.

changes.title: Local URL cleaning
changes.detail: Expanded conservative tracking parameters and host/path exceptions based on reviewed ClearURLs rules; preserves signed/authentication protection, raw functional parameters and original clipboard.
